name: Super Danganronpa Another 2 ~Huimangui Dalgwa Jeolmangui Taeyang~
original_name: 슈퍼 단간론파 어나더 2 ~희망의 달과 절망의 태양~
source: Super Danganronpa Another 2 ~The Sun of Despair and the Moon of Hope~ is a Danganronpa fangame developed by Korean game-developer LINUJ. It is the sequel to LINUJ's first fangame; Danganronpa Another.
translation: Super Danganronpa Another 2 ~The Sun of Despair and the Moon of Hope~ is a Danganronpa fangame developed by Korean game-developer LINUJ. It is the sequel to LINUJ's first fangame; Danganronpa Another.
